ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark charcoal) pixels. Dark pixels are concentrated in a central dense mass around the peduncle attachment, while high-intensity pixels dominate the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity contiguous blob spanning the median notch and basal region. High-intensity lobes feature sparse, non-contiguous dark vertical streaks on the left lobe and isolated horizontal/oblique dark lines on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 75 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke visible in the frame.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to higher-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve toward the outer terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast, textured clusters on the distal tips of both lobes; the left tip shows a concentrated grouping of raised, irregular white-and-grey pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal dark linear mark on the right mid-lobe; three distinct vertical dark linear streaks on the left inner-lobe; several shorter micro-scratches distributed across the white expanse of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular, jagged texture at the terminal tips (possible minor tissue loss or barnacle-induced trauma); heavy dark pigmentation 'dripping' pattern extending from the center onto the light-colored lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'comma-shaped' dark mark located on the mid-right lobe surface, isolated from the central black mass.
